question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me find the average overall rating for each preferred foot (right vs left) of players who have a potential of at least 85, but only using each player's most recent rating entry? I'd love to see the foot side and the average rating.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT pa.*
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN (
        SELECT player_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date
        FROM Player_Attributes
        GROUP BY player_api_id
    ) md ON pa.player_api_id = md.player_api_id AND pa.date = md.max_date
)
SELECT preferred_foot, AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_overall_rating
FROM latest
WHERE potential >= 85
GROUP BY preferred_foot;

question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me out here? I'd love to know which players were born between 1985 and 1990 and have managed to achieve an average overall rating above 75 throughout their career? Show me their names, birthdays, and what that average rating actually is!

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    p.birthday,
    AVG(pa.overall_rating) AS average_rating
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(p.birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1985 AND 1990
GROUP BY p.id, p.player_name, p.birthday
HAVING AVG(pa.overall_rating) > 75
